entities.name: Sergei Nikolaevič Nikitin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sergei Nikolaevich Nikitin was a Russian geologist and paleontologist. He took a special interest in stratigraphy and worked especially on the progression of the Jurassic of Central Russia. He was also involved in studies on hydrogeology aimed at water management in Russia.
